verdicts.statement: U.S. citizenship is required to serve as a U.S. senator.
verdicts.reason: The context explicitly states that senators must be citizens of the United States for at least nine years.

verdicts.statement: A person must have been a U.S. citizen for at least nine years to serve as a U.S. senator.
verdicts.reason: The context explicitly requires senators to have been citizens of the United States for at least nine years.

verdicts.statement: A U.S. senator must be at least 30 years old.

verdicts.statement: A U.S. senator must be a legal inhabitant of the represented state.
